# What Is a Side Effect?

#### Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App

## What Is a Side Effect?

React's model is simple: UI is a result of state.

The component function takes state and props, and returns JSX. That is its only job.

A side effect is anything a component does that goes beyond this job description. These include:

- Fetching data from a server
- Updating the page title
- Writing to localStorage
- Setting up a timer

These things interact with the world outside React's rendering system.

React doesn't ban side effects; your app needs them. But React needs to control when they run so they don't interfere with rendering.
